verdict.rationale: Bevy ships reference documentation with inline examples, and a separate official examples gallery whose examples run in the browser via WASM/WebGL alongside their source code. However, the API reference itself is described as static docs.rs pages, so runnable examples are not integrated into an interactive reference. Missing for 10: runnable examples embedded inside the API reference, evidence that the reference itself is interactive, and independent corroboration of reference-doc depth (community notes many examples but thin docs).
